title: A Crown of Gilded Bones
synopsis: In a subterranean gothic bone kingdom, a blind royal executioner obsessed with a lethal poisoner stalks her through the catacombs. Forced betrothal, knife play, 5/5 heat, enemies-to-lovers, dark magic, and royal treason.

characters.protagonist: Aurelia Vex - 23, lethal venom alchemist, razor-sharp wit, survivor of the Guild Purge, fiercely independent yet fighting an overwhelming physical attraction to the man hunting her.
characters.love_interest: Prince Caelum - 27, High Executioner of the Bone Court, blindfolded osteomancer with glowing violet shadow-sight, obsessive, terrifyingly lethal, dominant, possessive, secretly tormented by calcification.
characters.antagonist: Archon Malichor - Grand Chancellor of the Death-Lords, schemer seeking to usurp the calcified throne using stolen alchemical poisons.

chapters.title: The Ossuary Citadel
chapters.summary: Aurelia's capture in her apothecary; Caelum corners her in the dark, testing her pulse; knife-to-throat negotiation and forced escort to the Citadel.

chapters.title: The Velvet Carriage
chapters.summary: Forced proximity inside the midnight carriage; Aurelia uses fire-orchid sensory accelerant; electric tension explodes into a bruising, dominant kiss.

chapters.title: The High Court of Bones
chapters.summary: Arrival in the courtyard of skulls; Archon Malichor challenges Caelum's claim; Caelum threatens the court with bone-resonance; confinement in the tower as the Dead King's bell chimes.

chapters.title: The Catacombs of Starless Night
chapters.summary: Caelum investigates the phantom-venom in the cisterns; Aurelia slips through the secret ossuary flue; Caelum stalks her through the dark crypts; high-heat blade confrontation.

chapters.title: A Feast of Ash and Venom
chapters.summary: The Royal Equinox Banquet; Aurelia forced to taste poisoned goblets; Caelum looms behind her chair; exposure of Malichor's scheme; public blood-claim.

chapters.title: The Spire of Whispers
chapters.summary: Confined in the Executioner's aerie; treating wounds; stripping away armor; raw emotional confessions and explosive 5/5 sexual intimacy.

chapters.title: The Osteomancer's Riddle
chapters.summary: The Titan Bone core is calcifying Caelum's marrow; Aurelia synthesizes an antidote from rare night-herbs, saving his life.

chapters.title: The Garden of Nightshades
chapters.summary: Midnight expedition beyond citadel walls; ambushed by rebel assassins; fighting back-to-back; possessive rescue in the pouring rain.

chapters.title: The Shadow Inquisition
chapters.summary: Malichor forces a trial by bone-ordeal; navigating the Hall of Skeletons; Caelum's shadow-sight guides her steps through the death-maze.

chapters.title: The Midnight Masquerade
chapters.summary: Decadent masked ball; dangerous waltz among enemies; stolen touches and breathless high-heat balcony encounter.

chapters.title: The Tincture of Truth
chapters.summary: Aurelia discovers the secret of Caelum's blinding; vulnerability beneath the killer's mask; mutual devotion deepens.

chapters.title: Tethered by Bone
chapters.summary: Blood-magic bonding ritual to link their life forces; raw, explicit high-heat consumption in the subterranean pool.

chapters.title: Betrayal in the Shadows
chapters.summary: Aurelia's former mentor infiltrates the citadel demanding she poison Caelum at dawn; agonizing conflict of heart and duty.

chapters.title: The Poisoned Solstice
chapters.summary: The High King is murdered during the Solstice rites; Aurelia is framed; Malichor seizes the throne and orders her execution.

chapters.title: The Obsidian Oubliette
chapters.summary: Aurelia is cast into the pit of bones; Caelum defies the court, slaughtering the guard to break into her cell.

chapters.title: The Descent of the Executioner
chapters.summary: Reunion in the dark dungeons; binding each other's wounds; swearing total war against the usurpers.

chapters.title: March of the Calcified Dead
chapters.summary: Awakening ancient bone-titans beneath the mountain; Aurelia creates aerosolized mist-weapons for the siege.

chapters.title: The Siege of the High Court
chapters.summary: Storming the Obsidian Citadel; venom and bone-resonance magic shatter Malichor's legions in the grand halls.

chapters.title: Marrow and Ashes
chapters.summary: Final duel on the Calcified Throne dais; Caelum and Aurelia bring down Malichor, shattering his bone-armor to dust.

chapters.title: A Crown of Gilded Bones
chapters.summary: Coronation of the new Bone Sovereign; Aurelia crowned his Dark Queen; eternal blood vow and celebratory 5/5 heat.
